text:
First trip to Sapporo? Sapporo Station, Odori and Susukino are joined by one straight underground walkway, and the station end to the Odori end takes about 10 minutes. Which end you sleep at decides your mornings and your dinners 👇

😮 The detail most travellers miss is in here 👉 https://japanbystation.com/sapporo-where-to-stay-first-trip

We checked every walking time and train time against Sapporo's official tourism site and JR Hokkaido before writing this.

🚆 SAPPORO STATION

1️⃣ The airport train is 33 minutes at the fastest (¥1,230), six an hour in the daytime, and Suica works. Best for early trains, day trips and big suitcases. Evenings here are calmer.

🌳 ODORI

2️⃣ Chi-Ka-Ho, the walkway under Ekimae-dori, links it to Sapporo Station in about 520 m, open 5:45 to 24:30. Nijo Market serves seafood bowls from about 7:00, and the TV Tower is at the end of the park.

🍖 SUSUKINO

3️⃣ One subway stop further. Jingisukan (grilled mutton) is the dinner here, and some grills stay open until 5:00 in the morning. Busy until late, so light sleepers should go for a high floor.

❄️ WINTER

From mid-December to February the pavements freeze. Small steps, boots with grip, and anti-slip spikes from any convenience store.

💬 OUR TAKE

Odori for most first trips: you can walk to almost everything, underground when it snows.
